name: Trade Leg Statement V 05
definition: Scope|The TradeLegStatement message is sent by the central counterparty (CCP) to a clearing member to report all trades that have been executed by the trading platform.||The message definition is intended for use with the ISO20022 Business Application Header.||Usage|The TradeLegStatement message may be either sent:|- during the day (to report trades execution by batch) or|- as an end of day report.

StatementParameters.name: Statement Parameters
StatementParameters.definition: Provides various statement parameters such as the statement identification, the statement date and time or the statement frequency.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message (within a statement) and continuation indicator to indicate that the statement is to continue or that the message is the last page of the statement.

ClearingMember.name: Clearing Member
ClearingMember.definition: Provides the identification of the account owner, that is the clearing member (individual clearing member or general clearing member).

ClearingAccount.name: Clearing Account
ClearingAccount.definition: Identifies the clearing member account at the Central counterparty through which the trade must be cleared (sometimes called position account).

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
